card.fact_statement: Norina Tangaro-Casingal was appointed as a COMELEC commissioner ahead of the 2025 Philippine general election.
card.source_span: President Marcos appointed Norina Tangaro-Casingal, erstwhile director of the Commission on Elections law department as commissioner on February 10, 2025

target_qa_variants.question: من عُين كمفوض في كوميليك قبل الانتخابات العامة الفلبينية لعام 2025؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: President Marcos appointed Norina Tangaro-Casingal, erstwhile director of the Commission on Elections law department as commissioner on February 10, 2025
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated COMELEC to its Arabic transliteration 'كوميليك' to avoid mixed language.

backtranslation_en.question: Who was appointed as a commissioner in COMELEC before the 2025 Philippine general election?
